reason: Goedel-Prover-V2 combines scaffolded data, verifier feedback and self-correction; reports an 8B prover exceeding a 671B model on MiniF2F and performance at small test-time budgets. The gains are theorem-proving-specific, not general serving optimization.
title: Goedel-Prover-V2: Scaling Formal Theorem Proving with Scaffolded Data Synthesis and Self-Correction
